scope: Evidence reconciliation for the named target; never an automatic audiovisual verdict

checks.requirement: Approved target IDs, aspect ratio, resolution, timeline and playback FPS; original protected ranges preserved
Review complete phrases, setup/payoff, cut boundaries and meaningful reactions against picture and sound
Review requested framing, safe areas and motion; samples alone do not establish continuous coverage
Measure against the approved mix spec and listen for intelligibility, masking and cut artifacts; missing loudness metrics are unverified
If requested, native Subtitle text/frame readback, Thai lint and burned-in review; otherwise document captions outside scope in evidence
Read back every modified target, source path/ID, ranges and actual track enabled states; save and restore entry state
For requested renders: owned job Complete, nonempty output, ffprobe video/audio and audiovisual QC; for edit-only work document no render requested
